name: Amelia Chen
title: Mid-level Cloud Solutions Architect
summary: A results-driven Mid-level Cloud Solutions Architect with 5+ years of experience designing, implementing, and optimizing scalable cloud infrastructure. Proven ability to leverage AWS and Azure services to deliver robust, cost-effective, and secure solutions. Adept at collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical architectures.

Developed automated deployment scripts using Python and Terraform, accelerating infrastructure provisioning by 40% and reducing manual errors.

Optimized existing cloud resources, identifying and implementing cost-saving measures that saved clients an average of $50,000 annually.
Assisted in the design and deployment of Azure-based solutions, contributing to projects that enhanced system performance by 15%.

Managed CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins for automated application deployments, reducing deployment time by 30%.
Collaborated with development teams to ensure seamless integration of applications with cloud infrastructure.
Supported the maintenance and troubleshooting of Linux servers and cloud-based infrastructure (AWS).
Implemented Docker containers for various applications, streamlining development and deployment workflows.
Assisted in the automation of infrastructure setup using Ansible, reducing manual configuration efforts by 20%.
